label: Words of another portal's domain that must never show here
description_nl: 2026-11-11 owner (GamyFyStudio History said '26AS, AIS and TIS'): the shared boilerplate came from the tax portal and carried its words into every portal. core/foreign_words.py fails the selfcheck when one of these shows in a place people read. A portal whose domain these ARE (SimplyFile) overrides this chip in chips/ with an empty list. This portal's own: 26AS, AIS, TIS, Form 16, ITR, assessment year, income tax - SimplyFile is the tax portal: these are its own words.
